newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads - Outperform bar NZ long end.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads - Outperform bar NZ long end.

text.p: Australian bonds ended the week on a high note and generally outperform the dollar bloc apart from the long end of the curve to New Zealand which was unchanged amid talk of a NZ$500 million global EuroKiwi issue.
The Australian/U.S. 10-year yield spread is nearing key resistance at 65 basis points and where analysts believe a break could see a move t0 50 basis points.

A test of this resistance could be seen next week if the U.S. labour force report due later today proves strong and stirs up worries of a further tightening by the Federal Reserve and U.S. Treasuries come under pressure.
The Australian market is closed for the Queen's Birthday holiday.
Meanwhile, the yield curve steepened slightly as the market remained hopeful of an easing in monetary policy down the track.
